decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Heritage Statement, Design and Access Statement, 92429v01 (Issue 9) - Sheets 1, 2 and 3, Received 15 December 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the  awning is occupied.
Condition : 3 - The outdoor seating area shall not be used after 11pm each day and there shall be no recorded music played in this area.
description: Installation of an awning to the front of the building.
